main_measure.name: pooled OLS slope of 10-bar excess return on forecast
main_measure.threshold: slope t >= +2 with >= 200 cases and timing gain > 0 confirms; slope t <= -2 with >= 200 cases rejects

supporting_check.name: timing gain (book mean daily return before costs minus market-rise gain)

reading: all grid cases are kept, including those with a zero forecast, in a pooled OLS with intercept on the coin's drift-removed 10-bar return; the book's return before costs is the held position times the next bar's coin return, averaged over coins per day.
